name: orca-cli
description: Use the public `orca` CLI to operate Orca-managed worktrees, folder contexts, terminals, repos, automations, artifacts, worktree comments, and the browser embedded inside the Orca app. Use when the user says "$orca-cli", "use orca cli", "Orca worktree", "child worktree", "cardStatus", "spawn codex/claude in a worktree", "read/wait/send Orca terminal", "terminal send", "full handoff", "handover", "give this to another agent", "another worktree", "Orca browser", "orca artifacts", "share HTML/Markdown", "public artifact link", or "control the browser inside Orca". Prefer this over raw `git worktree`, ad hoc PTYs, Playwright, or Computer Use when the task touches Orca-managed state; for a web page outside Orca's embedded browser, use kapture, and Computer Use for webviews or other desktop UI.
